description: This file provides functions for initializing and performing timed waits on pthread condition variables, supporting monotonic clocks and nanosecond granularity.

methods.name: initTimedWaitCond
methods.description: Initializes a pthread condition variable with attributes, setting the clock to CLOCK_MONOTONIC if supported and not on Darwin.

methods.name: doCondTimedWait
methods.description: Performs a pthread condition timed wait, using relative or absolute timeout depending on OS and support.

methods.name: incrementalCondTimedWait
methods.description: Performs a timed wait on a condition variable for a specified number of seconds, using monotonic clock if supported.

methods.name: incrementalCondTimedWaitMillis
methods.description: Performs a timed wait for a specified number of milliseconds, supporting nanosecond precision.

methods.name: granularIncrementalCondTimedWait
methods.description: Performs a granular timed wait with nanosecond precision, adding waitTime to current monotonic time.
